// Test-side specimen of a production build, shaped from `.ai-dlc/knowledge/ // architecture.md` (worker protocol + module map) and the unit-01 functional // requirements. It is NOT a product asset and never ships: unit-01's own // index.html/main.tsx are produced by the builder. Keeping the specimen here // lets the layout-population tests exercise the builder's real gate commands // (`pnpm build`, `pnpm check-bundle`) without a second product entry point. import type { AsrEvent, AsrRequest, DiarizeEvent, DiarizeRequest, ExportEvent, ExportRequest, MediaEvent, MediaRequest, } from '../src/engine/protocol' const ORT_WASM_FILE = 'ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.wasm' export function bootGate(): void { const marker = 'zipscribe-boot-ok' const root = document.querySelector('#root') if (root) { const status = document.createElement('div') status.id = 'boot-status' status.textContent = marker root.append(status) } console.info(marker) } function refuse(message: string): never { throw new Error(message) } export function mediaPort(): void { self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent) => { const request = event.data if (request.t === 'decode') { void ORT_WASM_FILE refuse(`media:decode unsupported (${request.jobId})`) } const ack: MediaEvent = { t: 'job:progress', jobId: request.jobId, processedSec: 0, totalSec: 0 } self.postMessage(ack) } } export function asrPort(): void { self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent) => { const request = event.data if (request.t === 'transcribe') { const batch: AsrEvent = { t: 'job:segments', jobId: request.jobId, segments: [] } self.postMessage(batch) } if (request.t === 'loadModel') refuse(`asr:loadModel not wired (${request.device})`) self.postMessage({ t: 'job:done', jobId: 'noop' } satisfies AsrEvent) } } export function diarizePort(): void { self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent) => { const request = event.data if (request.t === 'diarize') refuse(`diarize: unsupported sample rate ${request.sampleRate}`) const frames: DiarizeEvent = { t: 'diar:frames', jobId: 'noop', frames: { speakers: 0, frames: [] } } self.postMessage(frames) } } export function exportPort(): void { self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent) => { const request = event.data if (request.t === 'export') refuse(`export: unsupported format ${request.settings.format}`) self.postMessage({ t: 'job:done', jobId: request.jobId } satisfies ExportEvent) } }
